listings.name: Jan Powers Farmers Markets - Powerhouse
listings.otherProducts: Artisan cheeses, smallgoods, bread, pasta, coffee and food vendors.
listings.description: Long-running Saturday farmers market at the Brisbane Powerhouse riverside venue in New Farm.
listings.caveats: Site announces a Christmas break (Powerhouse and Manly final market 19 Dec 2026, returning 16 Jan 2027; Eagle Farm final market 20 Dec, returning 24 Jan 2027). Source gives 'Lamington St, Newfarm' only; street number and postcode 4005 not stated on the page.

listings.name: Jan Powers Farmers Markets - Manly
listings.address: Manly Harbour, Royal Esplanade (between Cambridge and Cardigan Parades), Little Bayside Park
listings.otherProducts: Bread and baked goods, spices, other food and crafted treats.

hours.note: First and third Saturday of each month only.

listings.hoursAsStated: 1st and 3rd Saturday of the month, 6am to 12 noon.
listings.description: Twice-monthly waterfront farmers market beside Manly Harbour in Brisbane's bayside.
listings.caveats: Site announces a Christmas break (Powerhouse and Manly final market 19 Dec 2026, returning 16 Jan 2027; Eagle Farm final market 20 Dec, returning 24 Jan 2027). Postcode 4179 not stated on the page.

listings.name: Jan Powers Farmers Markets - Eagle Farm
listings.address: Eagle Farm Racecourse, Racecourse Road (Gate 4 for disabled parking; public parking via Gate 7, Nudgee Road)
listings.otherProducts: Farm-fresh produce, coffee, flowers, hot and cold food, bakery goods, plants and artisan products.

hours.note: New market; started 2026 per the site.

listings.description: Sunday farmers market held at Eagle Farm Racecourse in Brisbane's inner north.
listings.caveats: Site announces a Christmas break (Powerhouse and Manly final market 19 Dec 2026, returning 16 Jan 2027; Eagle Farm final market 20 Dec, returning 24 Jan 2027). Page describes the market as new, so check it is still running. Postcode 4007 not stated on the page.

listings.name: Northey Street Organic Farmers Market
listings.address: Northey Street City Farm, 16 Victoria Street
listings.otherProducts: Organic breads, local meats, sustainable seafood, cheese and other dairy, grains, preserves, nursery plants, coffee and brunch.

hours.note: Runs rain, hail or shine; the farm nursery stays open to noon.

listings.hoursAsStated: Open Sundays 6am-11am; most farmers leave around 11am, nursery open until 12.00pm.
listings.description: Sunday organic market run at a community permaculture city farm in Brisbane.
listings.caveats: Address comes from the Brisbane City Council event page (an older dated event); farm site says 'Windsor, Brisbane'. Postcode 4030 not stated on either page. Organic claim is the market's own ('certified organic' produce).

listings.name: Kenilworth Dairies
listings.otherProducts: Cheese, yoghurt, mousse, plus an on-site cafe.

hours.note: Closed Christmas Day and Good Friday. Cafe food service ends an hour before close.

listings.hoursAsStated: Monday to Sunday 7.30am to 3.00pm; same on school and public holidays; closed Christmas Day and Good Friday.
listings.description: Dairy producer in the Mary Valley with an on-site shop and cafe selling its milk, cheese and yoghurt.

listings.name: Maleny Dairies MilkBar
listings.otherProducts: Maleny Dairies dairy products sold through the MilkBar.

hours.note: Closed Monday, Tuesday, weekends and public holidays. Farm and factory tours no longer run.

listings.hoursAsStated: MilkBar open Wednesday to Friday, 9am to 4pm; closed public holidays and weekends.
listings.description: Dairy processor's on-site MilkBar selling its products to the public in the Maleny hinterland.
listings.caveats: It is a dairy factory outlet that sources milk from contracted farms, not a farm gate sale by the farmers themselves. Exact product list not stated on the pages read.

listings.name: Scenic Rim Farm Shop & Cafe
listings.otherProducts: Local produce, cheeses and gourmet pantry items (per Scenic Rim tourism); cut flowers from Elderflower Farm on site; Fifth Acre produce stall.

hours.note: Fifth Acre full produce stall Saturday and Sunday; self-serve produce stall Thursday and Friday. Kitchen closes at 2pm.

listings.description: Farm shop and cafe among working farms near Kalbar, with an on-site produce stall at weekends.
listings.caveats: The 8:30-4 hours are the site's cafe/shop opening hours; produce stall days are separate. Product list taken partly from tourism page. Phone is a mobile listed on the site.

listings.name: Green Shed Market (Tamborine Mountain)
listings.address: Tamborine Mountain State High School (street address not stated)
listings.otherProducts: Freshly picked produce from growers, flowers, bread, coffee, jams, herbs and plants.
listings.description: Weekly Sunday market run by the Tamborine Mountain Local Producers Association, described as bringing together organic growers.
listings.caveats: Only the regional tourism page was opened (not the market's own site); other sources give 7-11am or 7am-noon, so confirm hours. 'Organic growers' is the tourism page's wording, not a certification, so no organic tag set. Postcode 4272 and street address not on the page.

listings.name: Mulgowie Farmers Market
listings.address: Mulgowie Hall and Recreational Reserve, 7 Mulgowie Road
listings.otherProducts: Fresh local produce, homemade treats and rustic crafts.

hours.note: Lockyer Valley tourism listing shows Saturday 5 Dec 2026 only; monthly pattern (reported as first Saturday) is not confirmed.

listings.description: Country farmers market in the Lockyer Valley held at the Mulgowie hall grounds.
listings.caveats: Single dated event listing; recurrence unverified. Set kind to weekly only as a placeholder.

listings.name: Toowoomba Farmers Market
listings.address: Corner of Campbell and Lindsay Streets (beside Cobb & Co Museum, opposite Queens Park)
listings.otherProducts: Seasonal produce, local meats, bread, pasta, jams, seafood, herbs, plus artisan stalls.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday under the windmills at Cobb & Co, 7am to 12pm.
listings.description: Weekly Saturday farmers market in East Toowoomba selling produce direct from regional growers.
listings.caveats: Postcode 4350 and suburb East Toowoomba not stated on the market's site (locality given as Toowoomba). Carnival of Flowers period had extended special hours (Sept-Oct).

listings.name: Noosa Farmers Market
listings.otherProducts: Organic produce, nuts, olives, herbs, seafood, bread and cheese.
listings.description: Sunday farmers market on the Noosa hinterland side of Noosaville.
listings.caveats: Site mentions 'fresh organic produce' as a stall type, not market-wide certification.

listings.name: Tolga Markets
listings.otherProducts: Council describes Tablelands markets as selling fresh produce, preserves, plants, arts and crafts.
listings.hoursAsStated: First Sunday of the Month, 7am-12noon, Morrow Park.
listings.description: Monthly community market in Tolga on the Atherton Tablelands.
listings.caveats: Tablelands Regional Council lists time/place but not what Tolga stalls sell; tourism blog calls it supporting local farmers (spelled 'Marrow park'). Postcode not on the pages.

listings.name: Atherton Artisan & Farmers Night Markets
listings.description: Monthly evening artisan and farmers market in Atherton.
listings.caveats: Only the council list was opened; no product detail beyond the market name.

listings.name: Freds Pass Rural Markets
listings.otherProducts: Plants, poultry, crafts and food stalls.
listings.description: Weekly rural market at the Freds Pass Sport and Recreation Reserve outside Darwin.
listings.caveats: Council and NT tourism agree Saturday 8-1 (some web results say Sunday, ignore). Street address and postcode not given on pages; venue is the Multi-Purpose Hall at Freds Pass Sport and Recreation Reserve. NT tourism says produce is 'mostly organic' (not certified). Market's own website was not found.

listings.name: Rapid Creek Markets
listings.otherProducts: Asian and tropical produce, seafood, meat, dairy, bakery, preserves.
listings.hoursAsStated: Every Saturday and Sunday, 7am - 2pm, rain, hail or shine.
listings.description: Darwin's oldest market, selling tropical produce, some grown in Darwin's rural area.
listings.caveats: The market site still shows an old COVID-19 'temporarily suspended' banner (2020) at the top while the body and a 2026 copyright show it open; NT tourism confirms the hours. Confirm before publishing.

listings.name: Nightcliff Markets
listings.address: Nightcliff Shopping Centre, Dick Ward Drive
listings.description: Weekly Sunday community market in Nightcliff where local farmers sell fresh fruit.
listings.caveats: Mixed craft/food market; farm produce stated only by the Darwin council page. No street number, postcode inferred 0810 not stated. Market's own site not found.

listings.name: Berry Springs Markets
listings.address: Berry Springs hall (street address not stated)
listings.otherProducts: Local produce and gifts sold by community residents.

hours.note: Last Sunday of each month, March to December only.

listings.hoursAsStated: Sunday (last Sunday of each month), 8.00am - 12.00 midday, March to December.
listings.description: Small monthly community market under the Berry Springs hall.
listings.caveats: Only the Litchfield Council listing was opened. Postcode 0838 taken from Berry Springs address on another page. Council also lists a market phone and email; omitted as not from the market's own site.
